d: Thailand’s tourism industry is losing its magic. Foreign visitor arrivals have fallen 4.6% in the first ten months of the year, putting the country on course for a second consecutive annual decline outside the pandemic. Meanwhile, Pakistan wants to become the world's sixth-largest economy before 2050. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has brought forward by more than 25 years Goldman Sachs' projection that Pakistan could reach the milestone by 2075. But can the country really pull off this economic transformation?
